h1: The 6 Best Microwave Toaster Oven Combos of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Microwave Oven Combos: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the best microwave and air fryer combo ovens for 2026, compared on wattage, price tier and countertop fit.
summary: The TOSHIBA Countertop Microwave Oven Air Fryer Combo is our top pick for buyers who want one appliance to microwave and air fry. The OptiChef PRO MAX is the highest-wattage option at 1100W. The FRIGIDAIRE 1.2 cu ft and GE GCST10A1WSS are the lower-cost picks for buyers who want to keep spending under $200.
intro: Anyone who wants a combo appliance usually discovers that the label is vague. Some products blend a microwave with an air fryer, others with a convection oven, so reading the feature list matters more than the product name.

We reviewed the listings for these combos and ranked them on wattage, listed cooking functions and price tier. Several listings give only a few specs, so we note where detail is thin. We left out an over-the-range microwave since it is not a countertop combo.

products.name: TOSHIBA Countertop Microwave Oven Air Fryer Combo
products.verdict: A 1000W countertop microwave with air fry, from a brand that fills this niche.
products.description:
This Toshiba pairs 1000W of microwave power with an air fry function in one countertop unit. It sits in the $200-500 price tier.

It leads the list because it combines the two functions buyers look for in a combo with a clear wattage figure. The tradeoff against the cheaper picks is cost, since it is in the upper tier.

It suits a household that wants to replace a microwave and an air fryer with one appliance. The listing gives little on interior size, so check dimensions against your counter.
products.idealFor: Households wanting one appliance to microwave and air fry.

products.name: TOSHIBA OptiChef PRO MAX Air Fryer Combo Microwave Oven
products.verdict: The most powerful microwave in this list at 1100W, with air fry.
products.description:
The OptiChef PRO MAX lists 1100W and an air fry function, in the $200-500 tier.

It takes second place because its extra 100W over the 1000W Toshibas is the only hard spec advantage the listings offer. Beyond that, it is similar in function to the pick above.

Choose it if microwave power is your priority. Wattage alone does not tell you about cooking evenness, so read the full listing.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the highest wattage in a microwave and air fryer combo.

products.name: TOSHIBA 4-in-1 Microwave Oven with Air Fryer Combo
products.description:
This Toshiba is sold as a 4-in-1 with 1000W of power and an air fry function, in the $200-500 tier.

It is placed behind the first two since its listing adds the 4-in-1 label without spelling out the functions here. The core specs match the top pick.

It works for buyers drawn to the multi-function branding. Read the listing to confirm exactly which four functions it offers.
products.skipIf: You want a clear function list.

products.name: TOSHIBA 4-in-1 Countertop Microwave Oven with Air Fryer
products.verdict: A near twin of the other 4-in-1, explicitly countertop, at 1000W.
products.description:
This is another 4-in-1 Toshiba, listed as countertop, with 1000W and air fry, in the $200-500 tier.

It trails the other 4-in-1 only because the two are so alike on paper that there is little to separate them. Pick whichever is easier to find.

It suits shoppers who want the countertop label stated outright. Compare the two listings before choosing.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting a clearly labeled countertop 4-in-1.

products.name: GE GCST10A1WSS Countertop Microwave Oven
products.verdict: A GE countertop microwave listed with air fry, in the $100-200 tier.
products.description:
This GE countertop microwave lists an air fry function, and sits in the $100-200 tier.

It lands fifth because it gives no wattage in the listing data, unlike the Toshibas, though it costs less. You trade a stated power figure for a lower price.

It makes sense for a smaller budget. Confirm wattage and size on the listing before buying.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers wanting air fry on a countertop microwave.
products.skipIf: You want a stated wattage figure.

products.name: FRIGIDAIRE 1.2 cu ft Microwave
products.verdict: A 1.2 cu ft microwave with an air fry function at the lowest price tier here.
products.description:
This Frigidaire is a 1.2 cu ft microwave listed with air fry, in the $100-200 tier.

It is last because it offers the least detail among the picks, though it is the only one that states interior capacity. That figure helps judge whether it fits a family-size dish.

It works for buyers who want to spend under $200. Check the wattage and the air fry details on the listing.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting a combo under $200 with known capacity.
products.skipIf: You want a high stated wattage.

whatMatters.detail: Wattage is microwave power, and higher numbers heat food faster. The picks here range from 1000W to 1100W where stated. Look for the wattage in the listing title or specs.
An air fry mode circulates hot air to crisp food, which a plain microwave cannot do. It is why these combos cost more. Check the listing names air fry as a function.
Capacity in cubic feet determines which dishes fit. A 1.2 cu ft interior is a common mid size. Look for the cu ft figure and compare it with your largest plate.
A combo oven is bulky, and you need clearance for ventilation. Measure your counter first. Check the listed dimensions.
These combos run from $100-200 to $200-500. More money buys a stated wattage and a clearer function list. Match the tier to how heavily you will use the air fry mode.

faq.q: Is a microwave air fryer combo a toaster oven?
faq.a: Not exactly. Most listings here combine a microwave with air fry rather than a toaster oven. Read each listing for the cooking functions it names.

faq.q: What is a common mistake buying a combo?
faq.a: Assuming the name means the same functions everywhere. Check whether air fry is listed, and for the wattage.

faq.q: Is the OptiChef PRO MAX worth it over the TOSHIBA Countertop?
faq.a: It offers 1100W against 1000W, in the same price tier. If power is your priority it is the better choice.
Place it on a stable counter with clearance for ventilation. Follow the listing's manual for the first use.
Wipe the interior after use and clean any air fry accessories according to the manual.

faq.q: Why was the over-the-range GE excluded?
faq.a: It is a built-in over-the-range microwave rather than a countertop combo, so it does not fit this list.

finalTake: For most kitchens, the TOSHIBA Countertop Microwave Oven Air Fryer Combo is the simplest recommendation. Choose the OptiChef PRO MAX if you want the highest listed wattage. If you want to spend under $200, the FRIGIDAIRE 1.2 cu ft and GE countertop models are the options here.
